info.title: HireArt API
info.description:
The HireArt API provides programmatic access to the HireArt staffing platform.

## Authentication
All requests require a Bearer token in the `Authorization` header:
```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```

## Pagination
All list endpoints support pagination via `page` and `per_page` query parameters.
Responses include `page`, `per_page`, `total_count`, and `total_pages` in the response body.

## IDs
All `id` fields are opaque string tokens. Do not assume any particular format.

## Timestamps
All timestamps are in ISO 8601 format (e.g. `2023-01-18T12:34:00Z`).

## Rate Limiting
Requests are limited to 100 per 60 seconds per API key. When the limit is exceeded,
the API returns `429 Too Many Requests` with a `Retry-After` header indicating seconds
until the limit resets.

## Errors
The API uses standard HTTP status codes. Error responses include an `error` field and
optionally a `message` or `messages` field with details.

tags.name: Assignments
tags.description: An assignment represents a worker's placement in a job position. It tracks employment status, compensation rates, billing terms, and classification (W2, 1099, international, etc.). Each assignment belongs to one worker and one job.

tags.name: Expenses
tags.description: Expenses are reimbursable costs submitted by workers during their assignment. Each expense includes the amount, description, approval status, and supporting documentation.

tags.name: Jobs
tags.description: A job is an open position at an employer. Jobs define the role requirements, work location, employment type, and hiring targets. Workers are placed into jobs via assignments after accepting an offer.

tags.name: Offers
tags.description: An offer represents a proposed employment arrangement for a candidate. It includes compensation terms (salary, hourly rate, bonuses), start date, and classification. Accepted offers result in an assignment being created.

tags.name: Onboardings
tags.description: An onboarding tracks a worker's setup process after accepting an offer. It includes document collection, compliance checks (background checks, I-9), and employment paperwork. Each onboarding is linked to an assignment.

tags.name: PayCycles
tags.description: A pay cycle is a payroll period (typically weekly or biweekly) that groups a worker's shifts for processing. Use pay cycles to reconcile timesheets and track payroll periods.

tags.name: Shifts
tags.description: A shift is a time entry recorded by or for a worker. Shifts track hours worked, break time, submission and approval status, and project assignments. Shifts are grouped into pay cycles for payroll.

tags.name: Workers
tags.description: A worker is a person employed through the HireArt platform. Worker records include contact information.
